items.title: CJ McCollum noted in the walk-off interview that he went 1-5 on wide open 3's on Saturday and made a few more so far tonight.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
CJ McCollum noted in the walk-off interview that he went 1-5 on wide open 3's on Saturday and made a few more so far tonight.

(That was a team-wide issue, as the Hawks were 6-25 on what the NBA describes as "wide open" 3PA in that game)

items.title: So far tonight, CJ McCollum has largely looked like a 35-year-old guard on the second night of a back-to-back with travel.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
So far tonight, CJ McCollum has largely looked like a 35-year-old guard on the second night of a back-to-back with travel.

(Amusingly, he made a jumper as I was typing this.)

items.title: Lu Dort and CJ McCollum won’t play tonight in the Hawks preseason opener.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
Lu Dort and CJ McCollum won’t play tonight in the Hawks preseason opener.

Dort has a right knee contusion.

McCollum has a nose contusion.

items.title: CJ McCollum said he’s been working out with Kingston Flemings (and NAW) in the mornings and he praised him quite a bit.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
CJ McCollum said he’s been working out with Kingston Flemings (and NAW) in the mornings and he praised him quite a bit.

Said Flemings is “super smart” and “ahead of his time” compared to a typical rookie guard.

Also complimented his work ethic and buy-in and how much he cares.
